name.description: The tool's identifier, such as `issue-refund`. The `row` layout writes it small and monospaced.

label.description: The tool's human name, such as `Issue refund`, written before the identifier. Omit it when the surrounding rows already name the call.

risk.description: Risk level assigned by the policy evaluator. Read as Reads, Changes things or Dangerous in muted text; the glyph carries the alert.

irreversible.description: True when the operation cannot be reversed. Adds "Can't be undone", which never breaks across lines.

provider.description: Sandbox provider, such as Codex or a remote execution backend.

workingDir.description: Working directory for the pending operation.

sandbox.description: Optional sandbox context in which the operation will run.

filesTouched.description: File paths that the operation may read or write. Duplicate paths are collapsed for display.

argsPreview.description: JSON-like argument preview shown to the approver.

filesTouched.description: File paths that the operation may read or write. File-write approvals require at least one path. Duplicate paths are collapsed for display.

filesTouched.description: File paths that the operation may read or write. Duplicate paths are collapsed for display.

argsPreview.description: JSON-like argument preview shown to the approver.

operation.description: Operation details shown to the approver.

env.description: Environment variable names only. Values are ignored if accidentally supplied as `NAME=value`.

snapshotId.description: Snapshot identifier for the pending approval context.

policyVersion.description: Policy version that produced the approval request.

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key that makes repeated decisions durable.

expiresAt.description: Optional ISO timestamp after which a pending approval is treated as expired.

editableArgs.description: Whether approving with edited JSON arguments is available. Default `false`.

headingLevel.description: Heading level for the card title; section headings render one level deeper. Default `3`.

layout.description: Layout: the full `card`, the shared `row` (one approval inside a transcript or beneath a tool call), or the approval's own `detail` page. Default `'card'`.

question.description: The question the approval asks, such as `Refund order 4471 for $42.00?`. Default `Run <tool>?`.

source.description: Who asked, written after the source prefix: `Tool runner`, or `the agent`.

sourcePrefix.description: The words before `source`. Default `Approval from`, or `Asked by` in the `detail` layout.

eyebrow.description: The small line above the question in the `detail` layout, beside the risk glyph. Default `Tool approval`.

toolPrefix.description: The words before the tool in the `detail` layout: "It wants to run Issue refund `issue-refund` · Dangerous". Default `It wants to run`.

requestedAt.description: When the approval was asked, as an ISO timestamp. Written as relative time ("4 min ago") while the approval is pending.

consequence.description: What approving does, in one line, such as `Sends $42.00 back to the original card`.

rememberScope.description: Offers "Allow <tool> for <scope>" as a checkbox on its own line before Deny and Approve, with the scope written after "for", such as `the rest of this chat`. Leave it out for a tool set to Always.

decidedBy.description: Who decided, once the approval is decided: `you`. Written as "Denied by you".

decidedAt.description: When the approval was decided, as an ISO timestamp, written as a time of day after the outcome.

decisionNote.description: The note the approver left with the decision, written under the outcome as "Your note", the note, and a caption saying where it went.

disabledReason.description: Why Deny and Approve are off while the approval is still pending. Written above the actions and named by both buttons.

unavailableReason.description: Why an `unavailable` approval cannot be answered now, written beneath it.

resolving.description: The answer that is on its way: `approve` writes "Approving…" with a spinner on Approve, `deny` writes "Denying…" on Deny, and both buttons, the note and the checkbox turn off until the host clears it.

summary.description: What failed, in a few words, such as `Couldn't approve.`.

detail.description: The reason and what is still true, such as `Interborough couldn't reach the agent. Nothing was refunded.`.

failure.description: Why the last answer did not go through, written as a red-toned inline message below the consequence. Nothing was decided, so Deny and Approve stay live; Approve is the retry.

notice.description: A notice written beneath a read-only approval, such as why it expired or what happened elsewhere. Without one, an approval that passed its `expiresAt` says when it expired.

result.description: What the approval led to, once it is decided: written as "Result: Refunded $18.50 to the original card.".

decidedIn.description: Where it was decided when that was not here, such as `Reviews`: "Approved by you in Reviews at 10:44 AM".

footnote.description: A line of text written under the buttons while the approval is pending, such as what happens once you decide.

inputLabel.description: What the payload is called in the Input block, such as `Runs with`. Default `Input` in the row and `<tool> arguments` in the card.

view.description: Which view of the arguments the Input block shows, Fields or JSON. Bindable, so one switch can govern every payload on a page. Default `fields`.

class.description: Additional CSS classes applied to the root element.

unsupportedProps.name: context
unsupportedProps.description: A line of context written above the question, such as "Test chat · this runs for real".

unsupportedProps.name: onResolve
unsupportedProps.description: Called for approve, approve-with-edits, and deny with the complete resolution payload.
